name: navigation-menu
title: Navigation Menu
description: A site's main links where some open a panel of further links (a mega menu): the panel opens on hover or on Enter, and the arrow keys move between the top links, to the Radix navigation pattern.

meta.when: A site with sections that each hold several pages. For a few plain links use navbar (which also folds them into a sheet on phones); for commands use menubar or dropdown-menu. Below `md`, put the same links in navbar's sheet.
